summary: This clinical trial is testing a drug called ursodeoxycholic acid to see if it helps prevent blood sugar issues in people with high blood fat levels who take statin medications. The study is currently in Recruiting status with a target of 128 participants. Sponsored by First Affiliated Hospital Xi'an Jiaotong University, the trial is listed under NCT06684106. Participants will take either the study drug or a placebo along with a statin for six months.

facts.sponsor: First Affiliated Hospital Xi'an Jiaotong University
